title: [BUG] crashes with  `code: "ECOMPROMISED"`
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: `1.0.52 (Claude Code)` native install
- Operating System: fedora 42
- Terminal: gnome term

## Bug Description
Randomly crashes after some time, even when idle with
```
error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, stat '/home/user/.claude/shell-snapshots/snapshot-zsh-1752570785700-ac2kks.sh.lock'
    path: "/home/user/.claude/shell-snapshots/snapshot-zsh-1752570785700-ac2kks.sh.lock",
 syscall: "stat",
   errno: -2,
    code: "ECOMPROMISED"

Bun v1.2.15 (Linux x64 baseline)
```


## Steps to Reproduce
1. claude
2. wait some time - can be from 4 to 30 minutes.


## Additional Context

Delete of `shell-snapshots`, reboot doesn't help.

output of
```
 strace -e trace=file -f -o ../claude_trace.log claude
```
[claude_trace.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21230091/claude_trace.zip)
